title: Mr C Residences split band
description: A full-bleed colour band: a fine line-pattern panel fills the left 43% and a short text column sits right of centre, vertically centred, with a light uppercase head on two lines, tracked body copy and an underlined SemiBold uppercase link. In brick red with white text, or blush with red text. On phones the text comes first and the pattern becomes a strip along the bottom. The head, body and link fade up as they enter the view; the link's underline draws back on hover.
notes: tone 'primary' is a primary band with primary-foreground text; 'soft' is the background colour with primary text
the pattern slot replaces the CSS lattice (pass an image or another texture)
content-sized: section-y padding above and below the centred text
